Then we offer you the opportunity to further develop our most important trading partners and actively shape growth.

- Project responsibility: You take over the management for further customer projects in areas such as electronic process connection (EDI), logistics optimization, master data management or Category Management.

## Your wich

You don't just want to work, but also to think, shape and take responsibility? Then you are right with us. In our Swiss concept team you will get insights into the strategic and operational further development of our workshop networks.

You work closely with Concept Management and take on your own areas of responsibility depending on your skills and your own initiative - project management: You support the planning and implementation of projects and gradually assume responsibility for your own sub-projects – from the idea to the realization. - Business Development: You participate in the further development and expansion of our workshop networks, support acquisition measures and prepare decision-making basis.

- Market and data analyses: You analyze market potentials, partner structures and key figures, provide insights and make your own recommendations for action. - Partner and network management: You support the support of our workshop and wholesale partners and work together with internal and external contact persons.

- Events & Communication: You accompany the organization of partner meetings, workshops and other network activities and support in the implementation of communication measures What is important to us: We are looking for someone who not only does tasks but questions, develops ideas and wants to move something. How much responsibility you take over also depends on your initiative and your strengths.

## Your profile

- Training: Ongoing studies in business administration, industrial engineering, marketing, corporate development or a similar field of expertise. - Personality and working methods: You are curious, committed and like to think a step further. You participate in your own initiative, work independently and take responsibility. - Working methods: You have organizational talent, think physically and keep track of several parallel tasks. At the same time, you are not too bad to be involved in the operational day-to-day business.

- Experience and know-how: Very good MS Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint. First experience in project management, in data analysis or with CRM systems is of advantage. AI know-how also of advantage. - Languages: Very good German skills. French or Italian skills are a plus. - Interest: You are enthusiastic about economic relationships, innovative business models and ideally for the automotive industry.

## Contact & additional information

- Start: from 15 February 2027 or by appointment - Duration: At least 6 months, ideally longer – 20h/week - Prerequisite for student work is your enrolment at a university. - Please add your CV and a current enrolment certificate to your application. Your responsibilities instead of working purely: You get the opportunity to contribute your own ideas and actively shape projects. - Practical insights: You learn how a Swiss-wide workshop network is managed, developed and expanded.

- Direct cooperation: You work closely with concept management as well as with different departments and external partners. - Individual development: Your tasks and responsibilities can grow with your skills, interests and commitment. Apply now and become a part of the Bosch family at the branch office in Urdorf, near Zurich. Contact Personnel department Giorgio Luongo pac.switzerland@bosch.com Tel: +41 32 686 32 00
